data.name: DEPTH STRIKE
data.detailed_description:
Control the Battlefield


Your fleet has several special abilities that can change the course of the operation:

Naval Mine
Place a mine to block an entire sector, forcing the enemy to change course or risk their ship.

Missile Strike
Launch a powerful strike at a selected area and try to destroy multiple ships at once.

Radar Recon
When the enemy is hiding in the unknown, use radar to reveal their position and gain a tactical advantage.

Repair
Even a heavily damaged ship can still be useful. Repair your vessel and get it back into the fight.

Don’t Just Guess — Think Ahead


The enemy is constantly changing position. One successful hit doesn’t guarantee victory.

You may detect a ship, only to lose track of it on the next turn.
You can block a sector with a mine and force the enemy to change course.
Or risk a missile strike on an area where you believe the enemy fleet is concentrated.

Every decision changes the battlefield.

Rediscover the Classic Battleship


Depth Strike keeps everything we love about the classic game: the search for the enemy, the tension, the risk, and that satisfying moment when you finally find your target!

data.short_description: Depth Strike is the classic Battleship we all know and love, with a tactical twist. Ships reposition after every turn, so you must predict enemy movement, cut off escape routes, and strike at the right moment.
